incidents.title: Lock incidents ({{n}})
incidents.none: No session waited on a lock in this window. Lock trees are recorded every 15 seconds while one does (demo: demo/stage-lock-incident.sh stages one).

lockTree.preparedHint: two-phase commit, no session — see the Vacuum Horizon tile; ROLLBACK PREPARED or COMMIT PREPARED releases it
lockTree.notInActivity: not in this database's activity (another database, or it ended)
lockTree.deadlockCycle: Every session here is blocked by another — a deadlock cycle caught mid-detection.
